headline: 9 killed in Kolkata hotel fire; journalist and 3 family members from Kushtia dead
summary: A journalist, his wife, two-year-old son, and father-in-law are among at least five Bangladeshis killed in a blaze at Shikha Inn.
details: Nine people were killed in a fire at the Shikha Inn residential hotel in Kolkata early today. Among the deceased are Debashish Dutta, 37, a Kushtia correspondent for Ajker Patrika and Channel 9, and three of his family members.
The victims from Debashish's family include his wife, Afsana Shimmin, 25; their two-year-old son, Swarnashish Dutta; and his father-in-law, Akram Ali, 64.
The family had traveled to India for medical treatment on August 3. While Akram had been staying in Kolkata, Debashish and his immediate family arrived from Bengaluru only yesterday to join him.

Bangladesh's Ministry of Foreign Affairs has confirmed that at least five of the nine victims are Bangladeshi nationals. Another Bangladeshi victim was identified as two-year-old Ahmed Babu from Savar, Dhaka.

One other victim has been identified as 19-year-old Sandeep Paswan from Jharkhand, India. The identities of the remaining three victims are still being confirmed by local administration and hospital authorities.
caption:
A journalist and his family, including a 2-year-old son, are among 9 people killed in a devastating hotel fire in Kolkata.

Nine people were killed in a fire at the Shikha Inn residential hotel in Kolkata early today. Among the deceased are Debashish Dutta, 37, a Kushtia correspondent for Ajker Patrika and Channel 9, and three of his family members.

The victims from Debashish's family include his wife, Afsana Shimmin, 25; their two-year-old son, Swarnashish Dutta; and his father-in-law, Akram Ali, 64.

The family had traveled to India for medical treatment on August 3. While Akram had been staying in Kolkata, Debashish and his immediate family arrived from Bengaluru only yesterday to join him.

Bangladesh's Ministry of Foreign Affairs has confirmed that at least five of the nine victims are Bangladeshi nationals. Another Bangladeshi victim was identified as two-year-old Ahmed Babu from Savar, Dhaka.

One other victim has been identified as 19-year-old Sandeep Paswan from Jharkhand, India. The identities of the remaining three victims are still being confirmed by local administration and hospital authorities.
